move: three photo columns scroll endlessly in opposite directions under a difference-blend title
how: Three vertical columns of photo tiles (five per column, duplicated so the strip is seamless) scroll linearly over the whole 8s loop, the outer columns upward and the middle one downward, each wrapping exactly one strip length so frame 8s equals frame 0. A top and bottom vignette gradient fades the tiles into the dark stage. A huge two-line title (Config / 2026) in mix-blend-mode difference and a subline rise out of overflow masks (yPercent 110 to 0, expo.out 0.9s, 100ms stagger) at 5% and drop up out of them (expo.in) at 86%. The whole column group breathes from scale 1.02 to 1.08 and back (sine.inOut yoyo over the loop).
adapt: Replace the tile images, hue-filter skins, captions and the per-column height arrays, and the title lines. Keep the linear one-wrap-per-loop scroll, opposite middle direction and the 0.9s expo.out title rise.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the three columns with doubled tiles and the title inside el and computes each column's total height. animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with the scroll tweens lasting D and the title exit at D-1.1; column heights are absolute px for 720px tall stages.
caveats: several tiles carry hue-rotate/sepia/grayscale filters, mildly costly
from() tweens need immediateRender:false when built late
